verdict.rationale: Attio documents an official MCP server and says Claude, ChatGPT or other AI tools can connect to 'search, update and manage your Attio workspace'. It also has a REST API, a Deal object, full interaction history, and native AI that can 'create account briefs'. However, nothing shows an external agent can pull recent emails and interaction history through the API or MCP to assemble a pre-meeting brief, so only the core is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented email/activity access via API or MCP, a list of MCP tools covering deals and history, and hands-on corroboration of an agent-built account brief.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent compile an account brief — open deals, recent emails, and history — from CRM data via the API or MCP server before a meeting

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://attio.com/mcp
Connect Claude, ChatGPT or your AI tool of choice to search, update and manage your Attio workspace.
Draft follow-ups, update records, schedule next steps, create account briefs.
Get instant visibility into the full history of every interaction.
Attio provides a public REST API which exchanges JSON over HTTPS.
